name: events
description: Durable event bus: publish once, deliver at-least-once over HTTP. Other mini-apps and sidecars subscribe; failures retry with backoff, and past events can be replayed. Cross-app reactions without re-polling.
post_install: Restart the platform: docker compose restart endpoint-platform (applies 011_events.sql, hot-loads the app, starts the drain tick).

Subscribe an app: POST /api/events/subscriptions with {"app_name": "mfa-relay", "event_type": "mfa.code_received", "endpoint": "/api/mfa-relay/on-mfa"} (endpoint is a gateway path; wildcards 'email.*' and '*' work).
Publish: POST /api/events/publish with {"type": "mfa.code_received", "payload": {...}, "dedupe_key": "stable-identity"} — dedupe_key makes re-ingestion idempotent.
Watch: GET /api/events/health shows delivered / in-flight / dead per subscriber; POST /api/events/replay/{event_id} re-delivers a past event.
